title: T-Mobile's Friday Night 5G Lights Returns Bigger Than Ever with Over $8 Million in Prizes
summary: Back for its third season, Friday Night 5G Lights more than doubles its investment in America's small-town communities through expanded prize opportunities, including the return of the $1 million football field upgrade for one lucky high school as Patrick Mahomes and Rob Gronkowski return to champion the program T-Mobile (NASDAQ: TMUS) today announced the return of Friday Night 5G Lights for its third season, giving small-town high schools across America more opportunities than ever to celebrate their communities and compete for prizes that can make a meaningful difference. Friday Night 5G Lights This year's competition more than doubles schools' opportunities to win, with over $8.4 million in total prizes, a new divisional bracket format and the return of the $1 million football field upgrade grand prize.
